risks.title: Persistent Inflationary Pressures and Monetary Policy Tightening
risks.summary: Inflation remains elevated above central bank targets, necessitating continued monetary policy tightening. This risks slowing economic growth and increasing borrowing costs across the economy.
risks.watch_for: Core PCE inflation readings, Federal Reserve policy statements and interest rate decisions.
sources: Guggenheim Investments (October Economic Outlook and Key Themes, October 19 2026)
Stanford SIEPR (US Economy 2026: What to Watch, March 13 2026)

risks.title: Geopolitical Escalation and Trade Tensions
risks.summary: Ongoing conflicts and rising trade tensions pose a significant threat to global growth by disrupting supply chains, increasing commodity prices, and creating policy uncertainty.
risks.watch_for: Developments in the Middle East conflict, trade policy announcements, and statements from international bodies regarding global trade.
sources: J.P. Morgan Asset Management (Mid-Year Investment Outlook 2026, June 17 2026)

risks.title: AI Investment Boom and Potential Disruptions
risks.summary: The surge in AI investment is a key driver of economic growth, but it also carries risks related to market valuations, potential job displacement, and the need for significant infrastructure investment.
risks.watch_for: Corporate earnings reports from tech companies, AI-related capital expenditure announcements, and discussions on AI's impact on labor markets.
sources: Guggenheim Investments (October Economic Outlook and Key Themes, October 19 2026)
Stanford SIEPR (US Economy 2026: What to Watch, March 13 2026)
J.P. Morgan Asset Management (Mid-Year Investment Outlook 2026, June 17 2026)
Guggenheim Investments (10 Macro Themes for 2026, January 20 2026)

risks.title: Fiscal Vulnerabilities and Rising Debt Levels
risks.summary: Elevated government deficits and rising national debt levels in the US and globally create fiscal vulnerabilities, potentially leading to higher interest costs and reduced policy flexibility.
risks.watch_for: US Treasury deficit reports, CBO budget outlooks, and discussions on debt ceiling negotiations.
sources: Congressional Budget Office (Budget and Economic Outlook, February 11 2026)
Guggenheim Investments (October Economic Outlook and Key Themes, October 19 2026)

risks.title: Labor Market Dynamics and Affordability Concerns
risks.summary: While the labor market shows resilience, concerns about affordability persist for many households due to sticky inflation in essential goods and services, potentially impacting consumer spending.
risks.watch_for: Unemployment rate, wage growth data, and consumer price index (CPI) for essential goods and services.
sources: Stanford SIEPR (US Economy 2026: What to Watch, March 13 2026)

risks.title: Bond Market Volatility and Higher Interest Rates
risks.summary: The bond market is experiencing increased volatility, with yields remaining elevated due to persistent inflation and significant government and corporate debt issuance, increasing borrowing costs.
risks.watch_for: 10-year Treasury yield movements, corporate bond spread changes, and Federal Reserve's quantitative tightening program.
sources: Guggenheim Investments (October Economic Outlook and Key Themes, October 19 2026)
J.P. Morgan Asset Management (Mid-Year Investment Outlook 2026, June 17 2026)

risks.title: Energy Price Shocks and Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.summary: The ongoing conflict in the Middle East continues to drive energy price increases and poses risks to global supply chains, impacting inflation and economic activity, particularly for energy-importing nations.
risks.watch_for: Developments in the Middle East conflict, OPEC+ production decisions, and global energy supply reports.
sources: J.P. Morgan Asset Management (Mid-Year Investment Outlook 2026, June 17 2026)

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Geopolitical Risks Intensifying
risks.summary: CEOs are increasingly concerned about intensifying cybersecurity threats and geopolitical conflicts, which are seen as significant risks to organizational prosperity over the next three years.
risks.watch_for: Reports on cyberattacks, geopolitical risk indices, and corporate statements on risk management strategies.

consensus_note: There is a strong consensus across institutions regarding the persistent threat of inflation and the need for continued monetary policy vigilance. Geopolitical risks, particularly the conflict in the Middle East and ongoing trade tensions, are also widely cited as significant downside risks to global growth. While AI investment is seen as a growth driver, its potential disruptions and the associated market valuations are a point of attention.
